description: Public sources of the inputs. None of the corpora, model weights or checkpoints are included; the archive holds derived statistics, seeded subsets of per-target reference losses, training records, scores and one extract of released results. Each item remains under the terms of its original release.

sources.name: DataDecide
sources.used_for: perplexity table, evaluation sets, recipe token files (file list in data/datadecide/recipe_paths.json)

sources.name: Benchmark task text
sources.id: OLMES suite (allenai/olmes) and the task datasets on Hugging Face
sources.version: revisions recorded per task in results/bench_mismatch/forecast.json

sources.name: Public pretraining corpora
sources.id: Pile, SlimPajama, Dolma, RedPajama, DCLM-Baseline, RefinedWeb, FineWeb, FineWeb-Edu, C4 (Hugging Face)

sources.name: Forecast-test and development corpora
sources.id: wikimedia/wikipedia (2023-11-01), codeparrot/github-code-clean, HuggingFaceFW/fineweb-edu, TinyStories, the English datasets of Supplementary Table 1

sources.name: Forward-test corpora
sources.id: bigcode/commitpack, monology/pile-uncopyrighted, allenai/dolma v1.7, HuggingFaceFW/fineweb-2, Common Pile v0.1, pile-of-law/pile-of-law
sources.version: seeded draws recorded in results/extbench/draw.json, results/fwd_weblang/fall_line.json, results/fwd_english/fall_line.json, results/rate_singlepass/draw.json

sources.name: Reference models
sources.id: openai-community/gpt2, EleutherAI/pythia-*, HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-135M, Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B, Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B, Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B, Qwen/Qwen2.5-14B, Qwen/Qwen3-14B-Base, roneneldan/TinyStories-33M

sources.name: Published scaling results
sources.id: Limisiewicz et al., Compute Optimal Tokenization, Tables 2 and 10
